name: io.github.bardesss/arr-mcp
title: arr-mcp
description: One MCP server for the whole media stack: Radarr, Sonarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, Jellyfin, Seerr

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the MCP and config-UI port

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Host directory holding config.yaml, the write audit and the log ring buffer

config_dir.description: Directory on the host to keep arr-mcp's configuration in

environmentVariables.name: PUID
environmentVariables.description: User id owning the files in /config

environmentVariables.name: PGID
environmentVariables.description: Group id owning the files in /config

environmentVariables.name: TZ
environmentVariables.description: Timezone used for timestamps, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token shown on the arr-mcp dashboard once the instance is claimed
